messages.content: Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. Copy the span of words that lies between (and including) index 5 and 15, the indices are word indices, split by whitespace!

message.content:
FADE IN:

EXT. RIVERBANK - DAY

A gaunt FISHERMAN, weathered skin cracked like old parchment, yanks a silvery FISH from the churning water. The creature thrashes, gills flapping in the dry air, its irises wide and wet with panic.

The Fisherman lifts the fish high above his head, forcing it to face the sky. Above them, a total solar eclipse devours the sun. A ring of molten fire circles a perfect black disk. The world has turned to blue-gray twilight.

The fish's mouth opens. Closes. Opens again. It stares. The eclipse stares back. Two hollow centers of light and dark, locked in a silent, ancient dialogue.

FADE OUT.
